scope: identification, mechanical segregation, and refinery routing
identify: Confirm the material is an edge-contact finger section rather than decorative gold-colored metal.
Record source board type because plating and buyer categories vary by source.
Use Spike Glass and Board Sense confidence as supporting evidence, not as an assay.

workflow.title: Document intact value
workflow.instruction: Check whether the complete RAM/card/board has a better buyer category before trimming fingers.

workflow.title: Sort sources
workflow.instruction: Keep RAM fingers, expansion-card fingers, telecom/server material, and unknown edge contacts separated where practical.

workflow.title: Inspect contamination
workflow.instruction: Note solder, steel hardware, excess fiberglass, dirt, and mixed connector material that may affect buyer grade.

workflow.title: Mechanical segregation
workflow.instruction: When separation is economically justified, segregate the finger-bearing section without burning the board or creating unnecessary dust.

workflow.title: Label and weigh
workflow.instruction: Keep each grade/source in a labeled container and record net weight for price comparison.

workflow.title: Choose sale/refinery path
workflow.instruction: Compare specialty e-scrap buyer pricing with professional refinery terms and minimum lot requirements.

workflow.title: Time-value check
workflow.instruction: Compare added value from segregation against labor time before processing the rest of the batch.

hazard_policy: No burning and no garage-scale chemical refining instructions. Chemical recovery requires appropriate professional controls and waste handling.
